final: SELECT DISTINCT client_id FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998' AND t.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1998') ORDER BY client_id
